paragraphs.text: The Glacier Kingdom of Storgard (STOR-gard ) was a kingdom in the Dark Age and the onset of the Ice Age of Dominaria . It was located in the Sardian Mountains of Terisiare , near the buried caves of Koilos , and ruled by five clans: Ruby , Emerald , Onyx , Pearl and Sapphire . Because it had taken in refugees from Sarpadia , it sometimes is considered the last of the Fallen Empires .

During the Ice Age, the kingdom became covered by the ice of the massive Raynor Glacier , which advanced south multiple feet a year. Around the time of its destruction, it was the last stronghold of human civilization on Terisiare . The last king before the destruction by the glaciers of Lim-Dûl and Tevesh Szat was Miko . Around 2434 AR councillor Zilgeth was killed while fighting a Johtull wurm. After Freyalise was selected as his replacement and Oriel Kjeldos suggested abandoning the city, Tevesh Szat compelled Miko to arrange a duel between Freyalise and Jason Carthalion . After Jason won the duel, Freyalise ascended. Five days later, the house of Clan Emerald was blown up in an explosion that killed sixteen, and the Emerald and Pearl clans left the doomed capital. The Fall of Storgard happened not long after, claiming any remaining citizens. The refugees' descendants founded Kjeldor further to the south. Many years after the fall of Storgard, the city of Soldev was built on its ruins.
Storgard was ruled by a king and the Stone Council , a council of five clans, representing the five colors of magic. At the time of the Fall of Storgard, it was led by King Miko and consisted of:

Clan Pearl ( ) led by Hurn , who also served as Sergeant-at-Arms of the Royal Guard and later military commander after Zilgeth's death. This clan left Storgard after Jason Carthalion dueled Freyalise , thus surviving the fall of the kingdom.
Clan Sapphire ( ) led by Lorthun . They opposed leaving Storgard.
Clan Onyx ( ) led by Arimaya . They also opposed leaving Storgard.
Clan Ruby ( ) led by Zilgeth and later by Freyalise .
Clan Emerald ( ) led by Oriel Kjeldos and championed by Jason Carthalion . This clan also survived the fall of Storgard.
